mechanism: Valproic acid may displace captopril from protein binding and potentially increase captopril levels, while captopril may enhance valproic acid's anticonvulsant effects; both drugs can affect renal function and electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and serum electrolytes regularly; assess valproic acid levels if captopril is initiated or dose-adjusted; counsel patients on signs of hypotension and hyperkalemia.
